# AI Paste Cleaner

> Reveal and safely remove invisible Unicode, hidden watermarks, and AI typography from pasted text. Runs entirely in the browser.

## Tool

- [AI Paste Cleaner](https://jaydenyoonzk.github.io/ai-paste-cleaner/): the tool itself, a static page that runs entirely in the browser with no accounts and no data collection

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/ai-paste-cleaner#readme): what the tool does, how it works, and its engineering notes
- [Changelog](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/ai-paste-cleaner/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): dated release history

## Source
